personajes.descripcion:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

Akane Kurokawa is a rising star actress from the Lalalie Theatrical Company. Although a shy and quiet person, she is very serious when it comes to creating a good performance. She does a deep examination of each role she is given, allowing her to perfectly portray the character's personality and motivations. Akane is introduced to [Aqua](https://anilist.co/character/183885) as a fellow cast member on the set of the reality dating show *The Beginning of My Love With An Idol*.

__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) son. He is the twin big brother of [Ruby Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino).

~!He was previously a doctor named Goro, who became a fan of Ai through his patient named Sarina.!~ 

~!After reincarnating as Aquamarine and witnessing Ai's murder, he is intent on plotting revenge to the person who schemed Ai's death.!~

__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

An actress who was called a prodigy child. She has a rather stubborn personality yet an empathic side to her. She easily succumbs to pressure and while she does put up a front to others, she has very self-deprecating thoughts when it comes to her abilities. She's an honest and earnest person, who is very diligent and persistent even in the roughest of times. Also, she tends to place all responsibility on herself when it comes to others as she is the one who has the most experience in the show business world. She also hates bell peppers.
  
~!After the events of the Sweet Today Drama adaptation, she secretly develops a crush for [Aquamarine](https://anilist.co/character/183885/Hoshino-Aquamarine).!~

~!She longs for someone to look at her for who she is now and praise her efforts, someone to say that its okay for her to be here. And after the new B-Komachi's first concert, that person becomes Aquamarine after he waves her respected colored glow stick. Only reinforcing Kana's resolve to make Aquamarine fall for her.!~

Mikako is a junior high school girl who is in love with Terao Noboru, but was chosen to join a space expedition. While in space, Mikako always texted Noboru, even in dangerous situations. But still, Mikako was going far, far away from Earth. So far that her text messages would only reach Noboru after 8, 9, 10 years. She missed Earth and Noboru very much.
Noboru is Mikako's best friend with whom she is in love. He talks to her via text messages after she leaves earth.

__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) daughter, and the younger twin sister of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885). 

~!She was previously a patient named Sarina under Goro's care. Due to her illness, she was wheelchair-bound. After discovering B-Komachi, she had always aspired to be an idol although her condition kept her from achieving her dream. Since being reincarnated as Ruby, she is now working towards her dream of being an idol like Ai. To do so she's currently working with Strawberry Productions to revive B-Komachi along with Arima Kana and Memcho.!~
Author of "Tokyo Blade".

__Height__: 151 cm (4'11")

She's an idol and lead of B-Komachi, an idol group affiliated with Strawberry Productions. Her life took a turn when through an undetermined amount of time, she became pregnant with twins. Not wanting to squander her reputation, she and her team decide to hide this fact; having to play the role of idol and mother.

A Video Creator/Instagrammer. Her company "Video D" is located in Takachiho, Miyazaki, which is where ~![Goro](https://anilist.co/character/183885/) and [Sarina](https://anilist.co/character/183884/) lived.!~ She is friends with [Memcho](https://anilist.co/character/205434/) and helps her out by shooting & editing the new B-Komachi's first two music videos.

Frill Shiranui is a student in Ruby Hoshino's class. She is a multi-talented performer who can sing, dance, and act. At first, Ruby is in awe of her, yet they eventually become friends. 

 ~!She is the younger sister of [Koromo Shiranui](https://anilist.co/character/212391/Koromo-Shiranui) from [Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensaitachi no Renai Zunousen](https://anilist.co/manga/86635/Kaguyasama-wa-Kokurasetai-Tensaitachi-no-Renai-Zunousen/).!~

A member and founder of the original incarnation of B-Komachi, she can be identified by the panda hairpin.~!She was later revealed to have orchestrated the murder of Ai Hoshino with [Hikaru Kamiki](https://anilist.co/character/299249/Hikaru-Kamiki).!~~!She tried to stab Ruby on the day of her appearance in the Tokyo Dome, but Ruby was actually Akane in disguise.!~
GOA is a popular scriptwriter.

~!He is the father of Aqua and Ruby.!~

~!He is later revealed to also be Taiki Himekawa's biological father, having been molested by Airi Himekawa when he was a child before allegedly having her murdered as well by telling her husband about the affair.!~
Employee at Ichigo Productions.

Composer who has written over 1000 songs. 10 years ago he was one of Japan's top artists, and wrote almost all of his songs himself. [Miyako](https://anilist.co/character/223870) commissions him to write the new B-Komachi's new hit song, as he wrote many of the original B-Komachi's most popular songs.
Ichigo Saitou is the director of the agency Ichigo Production. He is the one who scouted [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) and made her a star.
She is a seemingly supernatural being apparently aware of everything that transpires within the story.
A weekly entertainment true story writer, a rather shameless person who has no problem with writing up scandalous stories about young actors provided that they are legal adults.

Third-year high schooler and professional musician signed with a record label. He writes all of the music and lyrics for his band and occasionally for others. He was a cast member of the reality dating show "LoveNow."
A stage actor in the Lala Lai Theatrical Company, who acted in the Tokyo Blade stage play adaptation.
A stage actress in the Lala Lai Theatrical Company, who acted in the Tokyo Blade stage play adaptation.
An idol from a company that wants to scout [Ruby Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino) to become its idol.
Mana Suzushiro is an underground idol who decided to stop her show business career after seeing the new idol group B-Komachi on stage.
Works at an advertising agency helping to promote the *15 Year Lie* film about Ai Hoshino's life. She is the mother of Sarina Tendouji.

A popular film director, currently the most influential in Japan. He has an honest desire to take care of the actors in his productions, but is also known as a playboy and target of tabloid reporters looking for industry scandal.
Masaya Kaburagi is a TV and Web-TV producer.
A stage actress in the Lala Lai Theatrical Company, who acted in the Tokyo Blade stage play adaptation.
A member of the original incarnation of B-Komachi, she can be identified by the cat hairpin.
Cosplayer who uses the stage name Meiya. She was invited by Ruby for a cosplay segment on _Dig Deep! One Chance!_.

Model and actor affiliated with Sonic Stage Productions. He appeared while still an untrained, yet arrogant, actor on the TV Drama *I'll Go With Sweet Today*. Melt was then cast in the role of Kizami in the 2.5D Stage Play *Tokyo Blade*.

__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

A girl who strived to become an idol at a young age, but due to her family situation, made sacrifices that ultimately ended with her becoming too old to become one. She is a YouTuber. 

~!Mem-cho's real age is 25, and she is later recruited as the third member of the re-formed B-Komachi idol group.!~
Cosplayer and VTuber under the name Komimi Suzune. [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/280874/Shun-Yoshizumi)'s sister.
She's a classmate and friend of Ruby Hoshino. Minami is a Gravure model who uses a fake accent.
Manager of SA Entertainment.

Miyako is married to [the president](https://anilist.co/character/245521) of Ichigo Productions and is [Ai's](https://anilist.co/character/172759) manager. She is a shallow woman who appears to have only married her husband due to the prospect of working with hot guys. She is also a babysitter to the twins.

~!After Ai's death, she becomes the twin's adoptive parent. As the twins blossom into adolescence, she becomes more mature, both as a caretaker and as a manager. She is also the manager of the new B-Komachi.!~
Nobuyuki Kumano is a dancer in 2nd year of highschool.
A stage actor in the Lala Lai Theatrical Company, who acted in the Tokyo Blade stage play adaptation.

A famous physical training YouTuber affiliated with Strawberry Productions, where he is the agency's top earner. On request from company president Miyako Saitou, he promotes the new B-Komachi by collaborating with Ruby Hoshino and Kana Arima in a physical training video on his channel.
A stage actor in the Lala Lai Theatrical Company, who acted in the Tokyo Blade stage play adaptation.

A shut-in, Ryosuke is a mentally unstable person who turns towards idols to feel loved in his life. He is an obsessive fan of [Ai Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/172759). ~!Ryousuke became enraged after learning of Ai's pregnancy and murdered Gorou Amemiya when the doctor interfered in his first attempt to kill Ai. Years later Ryousuke murdered Ai, fatally stabbing her at her home. Shortly afterwards Ryousuke commited suicide.!~
Sakuya Kamoshida is an actor specialized in theater adaptations.
Former Assistant Director on the online variety show "Dig Deep! One Chance!" Currently works as [Ruby](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino)'s manager.
Sumiaki Raida works for the company "Magic Flow". He is an executive producer on the 2.5D stage play *Tokyo Blade*.
Award-winning stage actor affiliated with the Lala Lai Theatrical Company.

Taishi Gotanda is a movie director, and the "mentor" of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885/Aquamarine-Hoshino). He still lives with his [mother](https://anilist.co/character/302910).
Mother of [Taishi Gotanda](https://anilist.co/character/245519).
The director for the web variety show Dig Deep! One Chance.
Leader of the Lala Lai Theatrical Company, and one of its founding members. He is the Director of the 2.5D Stage Play *Tokyo Blade*.
A mangaka and author of "Today will be sweet". She used to be [Abiko](https://anilist.co/character/237576/Abiko-Samejima)'s mentor.
Yuki Sumi is a model in 1st year of high school.
Top actress in Japan. Represented by SA Entertainment.
Mother of [Taiki Himekawa](https://anilist.co/character/245510/) and wife of [Seijuurou Uehara](https://anilist.co/character/344775/). She was a successful actress in her day.
Father of [Akane Kurokawa](https://anilist.co/character/203384).
Mother of [Akane Kurokawa](https://anilist.co/character/203384).
Director of the reality dating show "My Love with a Star Begins Now" (also known as "LoveNow")
The director of the drama series I'll Go With Sweet Today.
